verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training doc that says users can opt out of model training in Settings, and states HIPAA compliance for Enterprise customers. However, the evidence shows only a per-user Settings toggle, not an org-wide, admin-enforced opt-out, and SOC 2 is never mentioned. Missing for 10: an admin-enforceable workspace-level training opt-out, SOC 2 attestation documentation, detail on what data is or isn't used for training, and independent corroboration.
